plotEn:
Back in Black is a Canadian black comedy thriller film, directed by Ron Murphy and released in 2026. The film stars Christopher Walken as Clyde Mortimer, a struggling funeral director in a small town who is financially struggling due to the wellness craze meaning that people aren't dying like they used to, until his apprentice granddaughter Sam (Ella Ballentine) decides to take matters into her own hands to help her family's business thrive again.
